description: Prepare exiting a Midnight lend position before maturity: redeems withdrawable credit, then sells the rest to the best bid offers through MidnightBundlesV2. First call `morpho_midnight_get_user_position` for the credit and `morpho_midnight_get_book_quote` with side `bids` and the same amount. After maturity use `morpho_prepare_midnight_redeem`. Returns unsigned transactions, approval and MidnightBundlesV2 authorization first, plus a simulation and warnings.

amount.description: Loan token amount to receive for the sold credit, in human-readable decimals

marketId.description: Midnight market ID (`market_id` from the Midnight read tools)

slippage.description: Slippage percentage applied to the book quote (e.g. "0.5" = 0.5%). Bounds the units filled at the quoted average price.

userAddress.description: Account that sends the transactions and owns the position

name: morpho_prepare_midnight_take_withdraw
